title.narrative: COUNTRY FRAMEWORK OF SUPPORT TO UNDAP URT 2011-2015: ECONOMIC GROWTH - Component II, Project 4: Industrial Upgrading and Modernization Project in Tanzania

description.narrative: The Tanzania Industrial Upgrading and Modernization Project (IUMP) is a component of the UNIDO Country Programme for United Republic of Tanzania (URT) developed under the UNDAP framework for 2011-2015. The Tanzania IUMP aims at promoting competitive industrial production, improved quality and quantity of industrial output and facilitated market access at national, regional and international levels for local private sector enterprises. The project also intends to build country#s institutional and technical capacity to deliver appropriate services for local industrial enterprises via provision of the necessary trainings and advisory support on technology and business processes management.
